mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a weakening demand cycle, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), labor market tightness accelerates corporate wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which subsequently causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates strengthening supply chain conditions and rising corporate capacity utilization, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO has increased for 6 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) declines by more than 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline > 0.5% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS declines > 0.5% MoM for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in labor market slack (UNRATE) indicates accelerating inflationary pressures, which triggers a monetary policy response that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in CPIAUCSL and decline in UNRATE does not lead to negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.0% MoM), supply chain bottlenecks ease and corporate output expands, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 1.0% MoM, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.
